operationalFreeze.sourceStructuralDependence: Only reviewer-qualified, hash-bound empirical joint source draws; each whole draw supplies all available cells' nine source training shares, K, and six externally identified structural logit offsets. One joint draw index per replication; no independent marginal sampling, priors, default zero offsets or replicated marginal medians.
operationalFreeze.structuralDiagnostic: Early 2010-2014 versus late 2015-2018 training-logit OLS slopes; descriptive, not a break test
operationalFreeze.supplementalFamilyInference: For each baseline, centered circular block bootstrap of six annual paired absolute-error differences, plus-one one-sided tail probability; candidate p=max(two baseline p). Holm across fixed ten candidates at alpha .05; missing p=1/nonrejection. Approximate small-sample supplemental diagnostic, not original protocol acceptance.

script/regional_diffusion_uncertainty.py.entryPoint: Default CLI calls readiness only; future reviewed caller invokes evaluate_joint explicitly.
script/regional_diffusion_uncertainty.py.pointEvaluator: Calls existing regional_diffusion_next.evaluate_qualified only after every source/input/joint gate passes. Existing script and point formulas are unchanged.

formula.point: yhat_t=K*expit(a+b*(year-2010)); numerically clamped exponent as in retained code.
formula.parameterDraw: r_t=z_t-a-b*t, centered by training mean. Circular block3 sample indices shared across available cells; OLS refit z*_t=a+b*t+r_index(t), retain (a*,b*) together.
formula.jointDraw: One source-authored complete joint draw selected per replication under an explicitly sourced uniform empirical law. Refit that draw's nine training shares with its K using the same annual block indices; predict K_draw*expit(a*+b*t+source_identified_structural_logit_offset_t).
formula.intervals: Interpolated empirical 0.025/0.5/0.975 quantiles; report six-year descriptive coverage separately for parameter-only and joint intervals. Not full process-noise predictive intervals.
formula.stability: OLS logit slope in training2010-2014 versus2015-2018, plus late-minus-early; no significance claim.
formula.supplementalTail: 1000 circular block3 resamples of centered six-year d, common annual indices across cells/baselines. p=(1+count(null_mean<=observed_mean))/1001. Candidate p=max(p_persistence,p_linearTrend); Holm adjusted p is cumulative max((10-rank)*p), capped1. Missing candidate or missing baseline remains p1/nonrejection.
formula.acceptanceBoundary: Supplemental tail probabilities are approximate low-power small-sample diagnostics, not original acceptance, calibrated posterior probabilities, or a significant structural-break claim. Original strict MAE gate and all scientific/owner/central blocks remain intact.

script/regional_diffusion_uncertainty.py.sourceContract: Each prior requires independently reviewed qualified regional/technology long-run generation-share saturation, explicit source URL/version/date/locator/rights/hash and private authenticated source bytes. The joint bundle additionally requires reviewed source-revision, structural, sampling-law and dependence identification. Its authenticated machine-readable JSON must contain the exact draw arrays, years and law, not merely an unrelated paper hash. Each draw includes every available cell, a unique joint draw id, nine training shares, K, six structural logit offsets and matching prior hash. No synthesized fallback, independent marginal sampling, median replication, future-observation input or automatic zero-offset insertion.
script/regional_diffusion_uncertainty.py.privacy: evaluate_joint returns paired draws to its explicit private caller; default CLI does not print source rows, paired arrays or observations. No source acquisition or file writes by the engine.
script/regional_diffusion_uncertainty.py.countsMeaning: fitCount counts newly fitted candidate point diagnostics, not every OLS operation. bootstrapReplications is1000 per qualified candidate in a future execution; zero actual candidates and zero actual bootstrap replications here.
